title: Recovery after a recoverable fault
description: Starting in SAFE_MODE after a low battery event: recovery is refused while the violation is active, still refused at 6.9 V because of hysteresis, and permitted once the battery reaches battery_recover_v (7.0 V).
setup: TELEMETRY seq=2 battery_v=6.5 temp_c=22.5 attitude_deg=2.0 comm=UP sensors=VALID
inject: TELEMETRY seq=3 battery_v=6.9 temp_c=22.5 attitude_deg=2.0 comm=UP sensors=VALID
TELEMETRY seq=4 battery_v=7.0 temp_c=22.5 attitude_deg=2.0 comm=UP sensors=VALID
